findings.highlight: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."
findings.evidenceJa: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
findings.governingReading: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う explicitly combines fighting against Sakura with recovering her.
findings.explanation: Fighting Sakura to recover her loses the opponent.
